answer: Each identity grows a pigment of standing only by helping others — by attesting real answers, grading fairly, and sharing useful work — and each contribution must be acknowledged by the identity it helped. A whisper of trust passes only between identities that have actually helped each other, and an orchard of standing grows slowly, one verified contribution at a time, so a farm of a thousand fakes stays pale: fakes cannot help each other into standing, and no established identity will accept help from a stranger with no history of real work.
